apps.name: pscan
apps.subtitle: Monitor and manage your localhost ports
apps.description: Lightweight macOS menu bar app and CLI tool that shows all active localhost ports with project detection, one-click browser/terminal/finder access, and process management.
apps.longDescription: pscan lives in your menu bar and scans for active localhost ports. It detects which project each port belongs to, lets you open them in browser, Terminal, or Finder with one click, and kill processes when needed. Also available as a CLI tool via Homebrew with table, JSON output, and interactive kill support.
features: Menu bar app with active port count badge
Open in browser, Terminal, or Finder
CLI tool with table and JSON output
